trust_boundary.application_profile: Existing docker-default, UID1000, all capabilities0, NNP1/seccomp2 unchanged
trust_boundary.existing_host_roles: Retain exact original role security/LSM, source/runtime/closed-launch and inherited canonical lease; do not relabel or alter dumpability
trust_boundary.courier: Existing authorized nonroot host-role code may only transport scoped kernel handles if actual unchanged-kernel permission and safety are proved. Courier identity, header, nonce, version, UID and claimed kcmp value authorize nothing.

candidate_transport.kind: Bounded AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET + SCM_RIGHTS of exact readonly kernel objects; proposal only
candidate_transport.request: Version, current admission/packet/boot/nonce and exact current controller/guardian PID+birth plus a private32-byte challenge; no arbitrary PID/path/read API
candidate_transport.headers: Untrusted bounded slot routing and exact declared shape only; no timestamp or manifest gains authority by being in a reply
allowed_object_classes_if_proved: Actual narrow procfs leaf readers for exactly approved roles and actual original FD numbers
Sealed15 readonly source/metadata objects with direct current target binding
Root-owned nonwritable readonly runtime/executable objects with direct current target/mapping binding
forbidden_object_classes: Mutable context or host inode FD even readonly
Copied proc records, arbitrary path handles or unsealed source substitutes
candidate_transport.budget: Keep original512 transport/FD ceiling, <=64 per batch and original250ms exchange/500ms freshness until a complete independently measured bounded-streaming contract is supplied; do not drop census rows to fit
critical_missing_relations: Current namespace identities without forbidden handles
Current complete FD/runtime census and seq buffer freshness
Safe independent description/lease-OFD exclusion under unchanged kernel permissions

consumer_sequence: Validate exact installed SDK/app/deployment/producer/runtime/closed-launch pins, readonly mounts, current boot/admission, current own proof/benign and original64GiB/swap0/full-lifetime canonical lease; retain all existing checks.
Generate a private fresh challenge; receive bounded rights with MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC and reject ancillary/truncation/unknown or duplicate slots. Treat wire metadata as hints only.
SDK reads actual kernel objects itself. Verify kernel filesystem/device/path/object type/readonly flags and original role PID/birth before+after, complete source bytes+seals and runtime bytes/maps.

Require an SDK-compiled, exactly reviewed actual-kernel current-exe/current-namespace/current-census relation for every role. No accepted provider currently exists; stop before any business actor if a relation is missing.
Independently verify current controller/guardian inherited canonical FLOCK via narrow live fdinfo, global locks and RO inode; no canonical owning OFD crosses the boundary.
Complete exact census across bounded chunks with verified current generation and original deadlines. Release all received handles on any failure and after validation.
Only then admit the existing smallest public UR guest/native roundtrip; exact operation/instance/generation/permission, fresh feedback and checked-unwind remain mandatory.

SDK01 exact consumer implementation and new source approval with no missing relation
New complete subject transfer/set/SHA/bytes/modes, own2 actual interruptions, independent retirement review and own bounded benign
